display_name: 遮挡先验短程训练真实源样本一致性
description: 使用真实 DURA 源上下文与源先验，对原版和精简损失进行相同种子短程训练并比较参数。

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 64 source fit IDs x three views, received/anchor/innovation/variance/clean IQ

permissions.claim_scope: Short local training trajectory parity on known source records, not full training or target prediction equality

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only prior final epoch5; new zero-head correction independently reinitialized for each path
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Context contract and prior commit/ordered fit IDs match; no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both prior and source context are F/TX/V/target-free source only
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed prior and same initialized correction, no target selection

expected_artifacts: result.json: short training parameter and source output parity

dimensions: 64 source physical records x three views

rows.method: Original and pruned masked prior loss with same fresh recovery initialization, minibatch order and masks
rows.purpose: Check source training trajectories, not full target predictions
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026110612, order 2026110613, mask 2026110711, fixed source prior 2026110707
rows.scenario: 64 fixed source training IDs, three source simulation views
expected_artifacts: result.json: short training parameter and source output parity

notes: No F, TX labels, V or target data.
Source sample is derived from previously validated, source-only deterministic DURA context, not a new data contract.
Both short trajectories use same initial model, source order, masks, deterministic GPU settings and optimizer.
Each path gets a full warmup; fixed timing order is not a controlled full training speed benchmark.
Do not change currently running [计算环境] experiment; equal 192 source outputs do not establish full target equivalence.
